title: abicheck N-library audit report (audit_set)
description: Schema for the JSON document produced by `abicheck compare --no-baseline DIR -o json=...` when the operand is a set of libraries -- a directory, a package archive, or a multi-artifact/degraded stored ProjectSnapshot package (one-comparison-product F-23, ADR-068 D2). One envelope holding, per member, the member's acquisition state and -- when it was audited -- its own single-build audit document verbatim (audit_report.schema.json). OLD is declared absent for every member: `verdict` is always null, `changes` always empty, and no member is ever reported added or removed. Versioned independently via audit_set_report_schema_version; additive changes bump the MINOR component, removals, changed meanings, and fields moved into `required` bump the MAJOR component.

member.description: One member of the set: its acquisition state for this run and, when audited, its own audit document.
The canonical release match key -- the same key a two-sided directory/package compare pairs this library by.

display_name.description: The on-disk filename when known, else the member key.

acquisition_state.description: ADR-065 D1's per-member state. `declared_absent` means the member was audited (OLD is declared absent, so the audit is the completed outcome); never `not_supplied`, `available` or `ambiguous` -- an audit pairs nothing.

required.description: False only for a member an explicit --select declared optional.

error_type.description: The exception class behind a `failed`/`unsupported` audit, when one was raised.

report.description: The member's own audit document, exactly as `compare --no-baseline <member> -o json=...` emits it (audit_report.schema.json); null when the member was not audited.

taggedFinding.description: One member's finding row (audit_report.schema.json's `finding`), tagged with the member it came from.

evolution.description: Never `introduced` or `resolved`: no member has a baseline to evolve from.

audit_set_report_schema_version.description: This envelope's own MAJOR.MINOR version, currently "1.0". Each member report carries its own audit_report_schema_version.

no_baseline.description: The marker every no-baseline consumer recognizes an audit by.

library.description: The operand's name (the directory or archive basename).

new_version.description: The candidate version when every audited member agrees on one, else empty.

verdict.description: Always null: an audit reports no compatibility verdict.

comparison_scope.description: ADR-065's completeness section over the set's own acquisition record (report/comparison_scope.py) -- the same shape a directory/package compare carries. `proven_removed`/`proven_added` are always empty.

contract_coverage_exit_contribution.description: The max of every audited member's own contribution.

contract_coverage_failures.description: Every audited member's coverage failures, tagged by member; present only under --contract.

exit_axes.description: Each axis's contribution; `exit_code` is their max. audit_gate/contract_coverage/analysis_assurance/evidence_contract are the max over every audited member's own axis; operational_error is 4 when a member's audit failed (the same contribution a directory/package compare folds for a failed member); incomplete_scope/no_comparison_completed are ADR-065 D6/D7 over the set's record -- so zero audited members exits 1.

assurance.description: Per-member assurance lives in each member report's own run_outcome.

disposition_audit.description: Every audited member's ADR-067 disposition audit, folded (report.disposition_audit.fold_disposition_audits).
